title: Chargeback Deadline Salvage Board
oneLiner: A revenue-recovery console for medical billing teams that surfaces insurance underpayment and denial appeals closest to missing their last profitable filing window.
targetUser: Independent clinic revenue cycle managers, billing leads, and outsourced reimbursement teams.
keyUX: Sort expiring appeal opportunities by recoverable dollars, inspect the exact missing evidence, and push the next owner action before the filing clock dies.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop medical billing recovery console called Chargeback Deadline Salvage Board for independent clinic revenue cycle managers and billing leads. It should help teams rescue insurance underpayment and denial appeals before the final filing window closes by combining recoverable dollars, payer deadlines, missing evidence, claim status, and next-owner actions in one workspace. Include a recoverable revenue KPI strip, an appeal deadline priority queue, a payer-rule timeline, a missing-evidence checklist, an underpayment trend chart, and an owner handoff drawer. Design direction: use a financial-analyst aesthetic with deep navy structure, cool gray surfaces, muted green and restrained amber accents, and precise data hierarchy so the product feels fiduciary, urgent, and credible.
